{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify that each patient_id appears exactly once
assert df['patient_id'].nunique() == len(df), "Duplicates still present in patient_id after deduplication"
assert not df['patient_id'].duplicated().any(), "Duplicates still present in patient_id after deduplication"

# Check the treatment arm data
treatment_df = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check gender distribution in treatment arm
gender_dist = treatment_df['sex'].value_counts()
print("Gender distribution in treatment arm:", gender_dist)

# Check severity distribution in treatment arm by gender
severity_gender = treatment_df.groupby(['sex', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Severity distribution by gender in treatment arm:\n", severity_gender)

# Compute response rates by gender in treatment arm
response_rates = treatment_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean() * 100
print("Response rates by gender in treatment arm (%):\n", response_rates)

# Compute difference in response rates
response_diff = response_rates['F'] - response_rates['M']
print("Difference in response rates (F - M):", response_diff)"}
